title: Siege of Laghouat
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Laghouat", at revision 1380323743, opens: "The siege of Laghouat was an episode of the French pacification of Algeria. General Aimable Pélissier commanding an army of 6,000, besieged the city of Laghouat from 21 November until 4 December 1852, when the city capitulated. The brutal treatment of the inhabitants was part of the scorched earth tactic of the French army and one of the first instances of recorded use of chemical weapons on civilians." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16931833, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege in 1852". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
